extraContent.title: Freezing Crush
content: In 2nd Job, you unlock the passive <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/freezing-crush.png} tip={Freezing Crush (2nd Job)}> Freezing Crush which causes your Ice-attributed attacks to apply a stacking debuff that increases the %Crit Damage and %Final Damage of your Lighting-attribute attacks. Lightning-attribute attacks will consume a stack of the debuff

In 3rd Job, you unlock the passive called <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/shatter.png} tip={Shatter (3rd Job)}> Shatter that causes your attacks to gain increased %Ignore DEF per Freezing Crush stack
Below is a list of your Ice-attribute skills:

<bp_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/cold-beam.png} tip={Cold Beam}> Cold Beam (2nd Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/absolute-zero-aura.png} tip={Absolute Zero Aura (2nd Job)}> Absolute Zero Aura (2nd Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/ice-strike.png} tip={Ice Strike (3rd Job)}> Ice Strike (3rd Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/frost-ward.png} tip={Frost Ward (3rd Job)}> Frost Ward (3rd Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/blizzard.png} tip={Blizzard (4th Job)}> Blizzard (4th Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/frozen-orb.png} tip={Frozen Orb (4th Job)}> Frozen Orb (4th Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/elquines.png} tip={Elquines (4th Job)}> Elquines (4th Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/spirit-of-snow.png} tip={Spirit of Snow (5th Job)}> Spirit of Snow (5th Job)_>
Below is a list of your Lightning-attribute skills:

<bp_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/thunder-bolt.png} tip={Thunder Bolt (2nd Job)}> Thunder Bolt (2nd Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/thunder-sphere.png} tip={Thunder Sphere (3rd Job)}> Thunder Sphere - Does not consume (3rd Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/chain-lightning.png} tip={Chain Lightning (4th Job)}> Chain Lightning (4th Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/lightning-orb.png} tip={Lightning Orb (Hyper Skill)}> Lightning Orb (Hyper Skill)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/bolt-barrage.png} tip={Bolt Barrage (5th Job)}> Bolt Barrage (5th Job)_<tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/jupiter-thunder.png} tip={Juptier Thunder (5th Job)}> Jupiter Thunder (5th Job)_>

primary.shortDesc: When attacking, has a 31% chance to identify an enemy's weakness, granting you the following bonuses against them:\nDamage per Stack: +5%, Enemy DEF Ignored per Stack: +5%\nEffect Duration: 10 sec, Stacks up to 3 times
primary.desc: Successful attacks have a chance to debuff enemies
details: [Debuff]: Increases %Damage and %Ignore DEF against this enemy (stacks up to 3 times)
Can be stacked up to 3 times, once for each unique Explorer Magician to reach Master Level
Skill can be found in <tt src={https://grandislibrary.com/class-icons/link-skills/link-manager.png} tip={Link Manager (Beginner Skill)}>

primary.name: Three Snails
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 7, Damage 40
primary.desc: Throws a snail shell forward that deals fixed amount of damage

primary.name: Recovery
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 15, Recover 72 HP over 30 sec

primary.name: Nimble Feet
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10, Duration 12, Movement Speed: 20

primary.name: Maple Return
primary.shortDesc: Returns you to Southperry Harbor on Maple Island.\nCooldown: 600 sec

primary.name: Hero's Echo
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, increases Attack Power & Magic ATT by 4% for 2400 sec\nCooldown: 300 sec
details: To obtain this skill, complete the quest <link href={https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Quests/77/An_Arrangement_from_the_Goddess%2E} title={"An Arrangement from the Goddess"}>
Affects all nearby players

primary.name: Energy Bolt
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 24, Damage: 78%, Number of Attacks: 4 Max Enemies Hit: 4
primary.desc: Casts an explosive orb forward

primary.name: Magic Guard
primary.shortDesc: Damage Taken: -10%, Damage Displaced: 85% of damage received
primary.desc: Reduces damage taken (against regular monsters) and a portion of your damage taken will be redirected towards your MP

primary.name: Teleport
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 20, Teleport to the left and right with 190, and up and down with 295\n[Passive Effects: Speed: +22, Max Speed: +20]
primary.desc: Teleports you in the direction you are moving in with your Arrow Keys
details: Can be used in the air and on ladders

primary.name: Mana Wave
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10. Allows you to jump a greater distance.\nHold the Jump key after using to spend 20 MP to descent slowly for up to 5 sec.
primary.desc: Up jump skill
details: Can be assigned a Key Slot or activated by pressing the Up Arrow Key and Jump Key while in the air
After using, holding the Jump Key will allow you to slowly float down<bp_You can move while floating_>

primary.name: Magic Armor
primary.shortDesc: Defense: +90

primary.name: MP Boost
primary.shortDesc: Max MP: +20%, Attack Speed: +1, MP increases by 120 per level\nCritical Rate: +5% when equipped with a Wand

primary.name: Cold Beam
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 27, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Damage: 199%, Number of Attacks: 3, Freeze Duration: 8
primary.desc: Cast an erupting ice shard forward
details: Enemies that are hit will freeze and be slowed down
Deals increased damage to Fire type monsters

primary.name: Freezing Crush
primary.shortDesc: Grants Critical Damage: +1% per stack when attacking a Frozen enemy. Lightning-based skills consume ice stacks, granting Final Damage: +1% per stack.
primary.desc: Attacking enemies with Ice-Attribute attacks will provide a stacking debuff
details: [Debuff]: For each stack, receives increased %Crit Damage and additional %Final Damage for Lightning-Attribute attacks
Using Lightning-Attribute attacks will consume a stack

primary.name: Thunder Bolt
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, Damage: 210%, Number of Attacks: 3, Max Enemies Hit: 6
primary.desc: Lightning bolts strike down on nearby enemies

primary.name: Absolute Zero Aura
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 60 per second, Grants Status Resistance: +20, Elemental Resistance: +20%, and Damage Taken: -20% to you and nearby party members.\nFreezes up to 15 enemies periodically
primary.desc: While toggled, increases Status Resistance and %Damage Reduction (against regular monsters)
details: Nearby enemies periodically gain stacks of <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/freezing-crush.png} tip={Freezing Crush (2nd Job)}>

primary.name: Meditation
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 16, Party Member Magic ATT: +30, Duration: 240 sec

primary.name: Agile Magic
primary.shortDesc: Attack Speed: +2, INT: +20

primary.name: Spell Mastery
primary.shortDesc: Magic Mastery: 50%, Magic ATT: +30, Critical Rate: +5%

primary.name: High Wisdom
primary.shortDesc: Permanently increase INT by 40

primary.name: MP Eater
primary.shortDesc: MP Absorb Chance: 20%, Amount Absorbed: 10% of Max MP\nAmount Absorbed: 5% of the boss's Max MP
primary.desc: Your attacks have a chance to steal a portion of the enemy's %Max HP
details: Effectiveness is reduced for bosses

primary.name: Ice Strike
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 90, Damage: 335% Number of Attacks: 4, Max Monsters Hit: 8, Freeze Duration: 8 sec
primary.desc: Icicles strike down from above damaging and freezing nearby enemies

primary.name: Elemental Adaptation (Ice, Lightning)
primary.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 190, activates Elemental Adaptation.
Consumes 2% of Max MP for a 100% chance to block debilitating status conditions, and regenerate the barrier up to 7 times.
Cooldown: 240 sec.
[Passive Effect: Elemental and Status Resistances +20%]
primary.desc: Creates a barrier that blocks up to 7 Critical Abnormal Statuses
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases Abnormal Status Resistance and %Elemental Resistance

primary.name: Frost Ward
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 70, Max Enemies Hit: 8, Damage: 255%, Number of Attacks: 4
primary.desc: Cast a blast of ice pushes enemies and freezes and slows enemies hit
details: Deals increased damage to Fire-attribute monsters

primary.name: Thunder Sphere
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 55, Lightning Orb Summon Duration: 120 sec., Damage: 296%, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Number of Attacks: 3\nUsing the skill again with the down arrow key fixes the orb in place for 60 sec. Fixed Orb Damage: 296%, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Number of Attacks: 3\nDamage Against Normal Enemies: +170% (additive)
primary.desc: Summon an orb that strikes nearby enemies and follows you around
details: While active, pressing the Down Arrow Key and Skill Key together will fix the orb's position and attack in a wider range<bp_Right-clicking the skill will toggle ON/OFF the ability to fix the position by pressing the Skill Key without the Down Arrow Key_>
Deals increased %Damage to regular monsters by a flat amount
Does not consume <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/freezing-crush.png} tip={Freezing Crush (2nd Job}> freezing stacks

primary.name: Teleport Mastery
primary.shortDesc: Additional MP Cost: 20, Max Monsters Hit: 6, Damage: 340%, Stun Chance: 80%, Stun Duration: 4 sec.\n[Passive Effect: Knockback Resistance: +40%]
primary.desc: While toggled, using <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/mage/teleport.png} tip={Teleport (1st Job)}> will damage nearby enemies
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases %Knockback Resistance
Has a chance to stun enemies

primary.name: Teleport Boost
primary.shortDesc: Teleport Distance: Horizontal +65, Vertical +25.
primary.desc: Increases the teleport distance of <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/mage/teleport.png} tip={Teleport (1st Job)}>
details: Cannot be used at the same time as <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ice-lightning/teleport-mastery-range.png} tip={Teleport Mastery - Range (Hyper Skill)}>

primary.name: Shatter
primary.shortDesc: Attack frozen enemies with a 100% chance to ignore 2% DEF for each stack

primary.name: Elemental Decrease
primary.shortDesc: Elemental Attribute Resistance: -10%, Final Damage: +40%

primary.name: Arcane Overdrive
primary.shortDesc: Critical Rate: +30%, Critical Damage: +15%

primary.name: Storm Magic
primary.shortDesc: Deals 20% extra final damage against enemies with the following effects: Damage Over Time, Freeze, Stun, Darkness, or Paralysis

primary.name: Element Amplifcation
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: +50%, Damage: +50%

primary.name: Chain Lightning
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 44, Damage: 220%, Number of Attacks: 10, Max Monsters Hit: 6, Stun Chance: 90%, Stun Duration: 4 sec, Additional Critical Rate: 25%
primary.desc: Casts a lightning that bounces to nearby enemies
details: Attack has increased %Crit Rate and a chance to stun enemies

primary.name: Freezing Breath
primary.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 22, makes you invincible. Stun up to 8 enemies and inflicts 80% damage 4 times for 13 sec. Reduces enemy Magic DEF by -30% and Weapon DEF by -15%.
Stun Duration: +100% depending on damage inflicted with Freezing Breath.
Only inflicts damage to stunned enemies.
This effect lasts as long as the key is held, up to 10 sec.
Cooldown: 120 sec.
primary.desc: Binds enemies hit by the breath while also reducing their %DEF
details: You are invincible while casting but you cannot move
Reduction to %DEF can be considered as %Ignore DEF

primary.name: Blizzard
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 300, Max Enemies Hit: 15, Damage: 301%, Number of Attacks: 12, Cooldown: 45 sec.\n[Passive Effect: [Final Attack] Your attack skills have a 60% chance to strike a single enemy with a Blizzard, dealing 220% damage.]
primary.desc: Create a shower of icicles
